up: Retrieve distinct rows containing the drug's preferred name (from molecule_dictionary), target's preferred name and organism (from target_dictionary), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures) for approved drugs (max_phase = 4) whose mechanism of action is classified as 'PARTIAL AGONIST' (drug_mechanism.action_type = 'PARTIAL AGONIST'). Join drug_mechanism to molecule_dictionary, target_dictionary, and compound_structures using molregno and tid.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS drug_pref_name, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism, cs.canonical_smiles FROM drug_mechanism dm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE dm.action_type = 'PARTIAL AGONIST' AND md.max_phase = 4
